# OutlineDev

> OutlineDev connects software engineers, career switchers, and businesses with practitioner mentorship, contract software development, and technical interview preparation.

Rated 5.0 on Google (24 reviews). Sessions are 1-on-1, practical, and led by experienced software engineers.

## Key Offerings

- [1-on-1 Mentorship](https://www.outlinedev.com/mentorship): Personalized 1-on-1 sessions for React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, system design, and AI-integrated frontend engineering.
- [IT Job Support](https://www.outlinedev.com/job-support): Confidential on-the-job sprint assistance, live debugging, and code reviews for active engineering projects.
- [Interview Preparation Hubs](https://www.outlinedev.com/interview): In-depth technical interview guides and mock interviews across [React](https://www.outlinedev.com/interview/react), [JavaScript](https://www.outlinedev.com/interview/javascript), [TypeScript](https://www.outlinedev.com/interview/typescript), [Angular](https://www.outlinedev.com/interview/angular), and [HTML/CSS](https://www.outlinedev.com/interview/html-css).
- [Hire Developers & Freelance Consultants](https://www.outlinedev.com/hire/full-stack-developer): Contract and freelance software development for web applications, APIs, and client dashboards. Specialized hire pages include [React Developer](https://www.outlinedev.com/hire/react-developer), [Next.js Developer](https://www.outlinedev.com/hire/nextjs-developer), [Node.js Developer](https://www.outlinedev.com/hire/nodejs-developer), [TypeScript Developer](https://www.outlinedev.com/hire/typescript-developer), [Vue.js Developer](https://www.outlinedev.com/hire/vuejs-developer), and [Full Stack Developer](https://www.outlinedev.com/hire/full-stack-developer).
- [Reviews & Feedback](https://www.outlinedev.com/reviews): Authentic student and client feedback, verbatim Google reviews, and student feedback videos.
- [Technical Blog & Tutorials](https://www.outlinedev.com/blogs): In-depth, practical guides for Next.js 15, React 19, Vue 3, Angular, Node.js architecture, and AI UI generators.
